Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

A newborn sea lion pup struggles to stay alive, a celebrity bat's mysterious holey wings, and a zebra named Holly hits the spa!
At Sydney's Circular Quay, amateur pianists share moving stories through music while Guy Sebastian and Andrea Lam offer once in a lifetime performance opportunity.
Gwen finds herself with an impossible dilemma when she is forced to choose between Arthur and her estranged brother, Elyan. With one of them certain to die at Cenred's hand, who will Gwen choose?

Jessica urges Louis to make some friends of his own, only to get jealous when Louis' new buddy at the pool hall turns out to be a gorgeous woman. Meanwhile, Eddie is shaken when Alison buddies up with his former crush Nicole.

After meeting a group of Mightyena, Max befriends a Poochyena who hasn't evolved yet and decides to train it himself!
Dr Chris and Dr Xand are whipping up blood smoothies in the lab to show the incredible barrier that keeps your brain safe, and they've made a music video to get you moving!

Chloe's professor is too mean to give her any face time to talk over her poor grade.

So ugly he’s cute! Meet sharpei puppy, Mr Wilson who is running the risk of going blind because of the massive folds of fat that hang over his eyes. Chris is hoping an eyelift will allow Mr Wilson to finally see the world.

Chris tackles a tricky rescue—a mother duck and her three ducklings are stuck in a rubbish-filled pool at a building site. One duckling's already died, and catching these submersive birds won't be easy.
An eight month old kitten’s back legs have been shattered by a deliberate act of cruelty. Can Chris save eight month old Blackie?

Two peregrine falcons that live at the top of a high rise shopping center mall in busy Bondi Junction have been struck down with a mystery illness. Can Chris find the answer and return the beautiful birds to their penthouse home.

Chris faces one of his most traumatic nights when Bella the pug is rushed in. She's in labour with six huge pups, and during an emergency caesarean, Chris and his team battle to save the babies and critical Bella.
Kooky cousins fear Marie the Pomeranian swallowed bikini string. Chris diagnoses while they redecorate the clinic, then operates—cue a whacky homecoming.
A mother duck has decided to hatch her nine babies on a high rise balcony. It’s a terrible choice. There’s no food, water or shelter from the sun and no way of getting out.

Chris heads to the bush to try to sort out an intriguing call for help. Schnitzel is a sixteen-month-old dachshund with a crazy obsession that's putting his life in danger. Schnitzel won't leave the newborn calves alone and is in real danger of getting a kick to the head. The determined dog has already been trodden on and suffered a broken toe, however, farmer Scott is sceptical about the vet's left-field solution.
Chris races to save Toby, a schnoodle run over by a taxi. His frantic babysitters hope Chris can fix the punctured lung before they break the bad news to his holidaying owners.

A puppy nearly died from a paralysis tick bite when he was just a few weeks old. Now he’s struggling to walk and breath. His owners think their puppy has swallowed something but Lisa discovers Danny’s life is under threat once again.

Chris tries to find out how Splodge is managing to escape from his backyard by climbing straight up a three meter brick fence. The neighbors are all happy to see the little Houdini but Splodge is dicing with death.

A four week old lamb with a broken leg has been dumped at an animal farm. Chris has decided little Leroy deserves a shot at life and takes the lamb back to the clinic to try to save his fractured leg and his life.
A tiny penguin has washed up on Bondi beach after a storm. He's malnourished and having trouble standing up. When Dr Chris discovers the shocking issue, he must make a tough decision.

Chris leads an Australian vet team overseas to help the animal victims of Fiji's devastating cyclone. Working with him is his dad, Graeme, a vet with 42 years experience. Together they stitch up a horse which has been ripped apart by a piece of flying corrugated iron roof. Lisa has to make the adjustment from her hi-tech hospital at home to treating animals in primitive conditions. Chris is also invited to an exclusive island resort to treat a cantankerous pet pig.
A hit-and-run victim collapses in a designer dress shop. Willow, a seven-year-old Husky, can only drag herself along the ground. Chris comes to the rescue, but will Willow ever be able to walk again?

Xialong Zhang and Cao Guangzhi are two Chinese nationals who are caught attempting to steal proprietary information from Apple Inc., and Tesla's Autonomous driving vehicle for a Chinese competitor.
While a prisoner in North Korea, George Blake was recruited by the Soviets to spy on the British. He was caught and sentenced to prison but escaped to the Soviet Union.

In the 17th century, a long period of civil war in France and war across Europe, rebellious members of the French Parliament, dubbed The Fronde, defy the monarchy and this defiance does not end well for them...and changes the history of France.
How did one man succeed in relaunching the Olympic spirit and turn the Games into a global event?

The battle between the French and English for the French territory of New France hinges on the presence of the British navy. And the Battle on the Plains of Abraham is tipped to Great Britain by the solidly trained soldiers of the British army. This changed the landscape of North America.
Timing is everything, just look at what happened in 1848. How did the finding of gold in Sutter's Mill make an impact on the development of California and the history of the United States?

While the graphic art of Ancient Egypt is very familiar, little is known about the artists and scribes. Who were they? How important were they to the Pharaohs? From Saqqara to the Valley of Kings, explore the lives of our first historians on record.
The dinosaurs had a long and glorious reign, but it was not to last, and with their passing, a land of opportunity was laid bare for the little mammals that had scampered about their feet.
Ghosts and ghouls go bump in the night, but so do many of the planet's most weird and wonderful creatures. The list of the secret creatures of the dark is endless, fascinating, and bizarre.

Like animals, the lives of plants are a race to grow and breed, to make sure they leave a genetic legacy. They must race to beat their communities to the best light spots or to make the most of short seasons. And to breed some catapult offspring around the forest, some use the wind.

Under the burning sun of Cape Cross, large colonies of seals gather on Namibia's Skeleton Coast...The males, who can weigh up to 360 kg, patrol the territory to protect their females and young. But new predators are coming from the land, forcing them to learn new defense behaviors.

In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

In the depths of the ocean, swift and agile sea lions perform incredible underwater maneuvers to outwit their enemies. Here, on the beaches of Patagonia, as a sea lion pup learns to swim, predators are preparing an attack on him, one that will be fatal.
Cape Gannets are tough hunters flying over the coasts for their favorite prey: shoals of sardines, waiting for a surprising ally: dolphins.

Everyone is called to some measure of leadership, and each one of us influences others more than we realize. If you love God with all your heart, mind, soul, and strength, and do what He tells you to do, you'll be a godly leader.

Pastor Doug Batchelor provides practical guidance into Christian living and prophecy.

Pastor Joel Osteen shepherds the largest and fastest growing congregation in America with relatable biblical principles and encouragement by following in step with his father's lead when he founded Lakewood Church in Houston, Texas.

International speakers Kenneth and Gloria Copeland offer viewers a series of inspirational, powerful and encouraging biblical teachings and principles from the subjects of love, faith, healing, redemption, righteousness, and much more.

Fire up the fifties see Kelly Tedder, Travis Hart, David Wurst, Drew Petrie, and Garret Iwanicki kicking some serious tail on all types of terrain as we preview the new mini bike movie FAD. Get to know "Fluffer" the next generation of FMX riders in our BLOWIN' UP feature. ENJOY!

S1 E13Fuel TV's first show dedicated strictly to freestyle motocross has concluded their first season. This episode of M80 showcases the best footage from all twelve episodes. A look back at the most innovative riders dialing in ground breaking tricks such as the double flip, corolla, wall-ride, peg-grind, and reverse 360. Cringe at the years boggest wrecks and see the cream of the crop ruling on natural terrain.

S1 E7While Jeffrey Herlings breaks the all-time record and enters into legend territory, Mattia Guadagnini gets his first MXGP podium, and Simon Längenfelder evokes his take on life and motocross before showing his dominance in Spain.

p.t: Just Getting Started - Learning from the Best
p.d: S1 E2The Norco Race Division is back at it after a tough opening weekend of the UCI Downhill World Cup in Fort William, Scotland. Greg Minnaar is back on the bike, still carrying an injury. All eyes are on Gracey Hemstreet, the young gun who has some very experienced support guiding her along the way.
A mockumentary follows pro surfer Andrew Gessler as he navigates the evolving surf culture with sarcastic wit and playful resistance to modern changes in the sport.

S3 E11The stories of perfect J-Bay reach the crew from Kelly Slater via cell phone, so the crew can't get there fast enough. The crew arrives late in the afternoon but just in time to see the swell coming in. they meet up with Kelly the next morning and surf flawless J-Bay. Being hailed  as the best right point in the world you wouldn't imagine how hard it is to actually ride the wave. Dropping in on waves stretching over a mile long, the crew finds it hard to sometimes keep up.

p.t: Drive Thru - South Africa - The Bungee Jump
p.d: S3 E12After almost two weeks of traveling, the crew can barley believe their luck, and decide to keep the wild experience going by trying the world's largest bungee jump. 1000 feet on the first jump and 750 the second time down leaves half the crew watching and the other half shivering in there boots. Judging by weight means that Donnie goes first, and after 30 minutes of racking up the nerves, he makes the jump. Then one by one the rest of the crew commits virtual suicide while the others watch in awe from the cliff.

S1 E5Shannon and Shayne pack up and move to the Caribbean and see what's it like to live in the tropics.  Once there they join the wild Carnival, run into Roxy girls and Jimmy Buffett, and surf the Caribbean's most elusive and perfect wave set in a secret bay, said to be the hideout of the notorious pirate blackbeard.

S1 E6Shannon and Shayne search for surf in the Mediterranean and discover a unique surf culture blooming in Italy.  While there they take a course in the ancient martial art of Gladiating, as well as learn to cook a classic Italian meal.

p.t: Camp Woodward: The Good, The Bad and the Funny
p.d: S3 E1Three new shredders, Zane Timpson (skate), Sean Ricany (BMX), and Jovon Vest (skate), kick off the action-packed and drama-filled new season.

p.t: Camp Woodward: Arrival, Shred and Injury?
p.d: S3 E2Zane wastes no time shredding the camp, while Jovon socializes with the other camp-goers, and Sean shows early signs of being this season's trouble-maker.

p.t: Built to Shred: Bark Beetle Juice
p.d: S3 E7In this frosty episode of Built To Shred host Jeff king takes his crew to Utah for a triple treat of skate and snow.  The crew visits DC's Mountain Lab with Haldor Helgason and Torstein Horgmo, shred's the inside of the Skull Candy offices with Adam Dyet and friends, and chops down the bark beedle at powder mountain with a little help from the Signal Snowboard team.

p.t: Built to Shred: Skullcandy Potluck Junk Jam
p.d: S3 E8In this episode host Jeff King and the crew help Skullcandy throw a grand opening potluck party at their new office in San Clemente by bringing in truckloads of junk and building all sorts of shredable contraptions.  Everyone brings a useless weird object, which the boys convert into obstacles.

TAPS heads to Roselle Park, New Jersey to investigate an Italian restaurant plagued by a deceased owner.
TAPS travels to Guthrie, OK to investigate The Stone Lion Inn, a bed and breakfast with paranormal phenomenon.
The Stanley Hotel, inspiration for Stephen King’s “The Shining”, is the setting for this TAPS investigation.

Donna suggests that the TAPS team travel to Tombstone, Arizona, in order to investigate the possibility of paranormal activity at the Birdcage Theater, a former drinking and burlesque hall that is the only remaining original building in the town.
TAPS continue their investigation into the paranormal history of the old west by heading to Bisbee, Arizona to uncover the secrets at The Copper Queen Hotel.
The team travels to a Vermont home and investigates the closed West Virginia State Penitentiary in Moundsville, West Virginia to investigate phenomena attributed to shadow people.
In Massachusetts, TAPSexplores a Victorian mansion with a bizarre history of unexplained activity.

The legendary hotel that served as inspiration for Stephen King's horror novel The Shining has an extensive history of mysterious and unexplainable phenomena, such as reports of the sounds of children playing in the halls on the fourth floor.

This series showcases a variety of uniquely Christian Kiwi content produced at Fantail Studios. Jared shares his heart behind them and the call that God has for each of us in sharing testimonies and to seek His Kingdom.

Canada Out of Doors highlights the adventures of Northern Ontario tourism outfitter and seaplane pilot Joel Theriault from Air Ivanhoe. Joel has been guiding fishermen since the age of 6, hunters since the age of 16. Watch Joel and his friends tackle exciting work projects at remote outpost cottages, fish and hunt after a hard day's work, and creatively prepare meals with the fish and game they find. This TV series is a blend of flying, exploring, construction and renovations, camp life, fishing, hunting, and cooking of wild game.
Pastor Neil Tomba continues his cycling journey engaging with people from all walks of life in real conversation about faith, their stories, and things that matter most.

In the cold winter of 1860, a young mother trapped in slavery seizes the opportunity to escape with her family when she encounters Harriet Tubman. Harriet leads the young family through a number of trials on the Underground Railroad, causing them all to question whether or not freedom is worth the price they must pay to obtain it.

Gary Kent is the speaker for The Incredible Journey. He is an archaeologist who has excavated numerous sites throughout Israel and Jordan. He holds a BA in Theology, MA in Ancient History And Archaeology, and M in Divinity. As an internationally-acclaimed speaker and TV presenter, he has spoken and produced numerous documentaries on subjects including the Bible, Bible prophecy, world events, historical places and natural health. His passion is to share the good news of Jesus’ soon return.

Powerful, life filled topics are presented in an enjoyable and proven format. Hosts, Brendon and Cathie have poured their 30 years of experience with kids in schools and in ministry and the great goals of the local church into a energetic show that will engage the next generation.

Connect follows a plucky school theatre group that aspires to stage every book of the Bible. The kids are pretty sure they have a clear understanding of everything that happens in 'God's Big Story'. Well…most of it.
The family takes shelter at Anklejelly Manor, but will they survive a Fang army attack?

Katherine Ruonala shares a practical message of love and hope to the nations. Reaching across denominational walls, her ministry is used to spread the fires of revival and ignite a fresh passion in the hearts of believers to go deeper in their relationship with God. Katherine carries a strong prophetic and miracle anointing with many experiencing instant healing in her meetings.
Gary Hoogvliet, a very tall man, interviews interesting folk, not quite as tall as he, but nevertheless with fascinating and inspiring stories to tell.

Over 1 million Australians are currently battling a form of eating disorder. Eating disorders can take control of an individual's life and have a devastating effect, if left untreated. In this episode we hear first hand from guest Angie Cahill how eating disorders can develop and the journey to recovery.
As graduation approaches, Elizabeth and Nathan plan for a happy summer together. Lucas and Edie race Rosemary and Bill to find the gold. The town plans a sweet surprise for Minnie.

17-year old Makyla founded non-profit Baila Conmigo to offer free dance programs to children in need. Lacey and her team are ready to recognise this inspiring youth leader by throwing her a graduation party she'll never forget.
In the first episode, Tim finds himself in Philadelphia, PA famous for its rich US history, Philly cheesesteak, and boxing legends.
This video explores how the famed Christmas hymns of today came into being, and the marked highlights of what makes these Christmas songs so memorable.

Desiree Nielsen blends watermelon and cucumber juice, then she makes morning porridge with millet, toasted nuts and almond milk, and she stuffs Portobello mushrooms with roasted red pepper, artichokes and cheese, then pairs charmoula with eggplant.
Desiree Nielsen shows how beets can make the icing on a delectable cupcake vibrant and delicious.

Desiree Nielsen shows off her technique for Japanese matcha tea, then she pairs spiced lentils with protein-packed eggs and serves mushroom bisque with thyme, and shares her take on banana bread and pairs king oyster mushrooms with parsley sauce.
It's beets for breakfast with host Desiree Nielsen. This surprising early morning addition gives you a reason to get out of bed!

Unlock Gusto TV's top recipes on QR Countdown! Thousands of viewers scan our QR codes to access our delicious dishes. Now, we're serving up 8 of our most popular snack recipes, from hosts like Kyle Crawford and Vanessa Gianfrancesco.

Bustling markets and sizzling sounds inspire a griddled tour of street food. From sweet to savory, each dish captures the rhythm of streets worldwide reflecting the traditions and bold character of flavors everywhere.
Nature, flavorful aromas, and the sound of a sizzling griddle make the campsite come alive. Each dish brings warmth, comfort, and ease to meals made in the great outdoors.

Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from Brie Larson and Courtney McBroom’s cookbook Party People! Follow along as Shahir makes pineapple right-side-up cake, mushroom pâté, and a breakfast taco casserole!
It's all about the letter \.

Chef-host Shahir Massoud cooks from the award-winning cookbook Chinese-ish by Joanna Hu and Rosheen Kaul, whipping up billionaire-worthy fried rice, Aussie-inspired shrimp toast, comforting chicken soup and more.

Chef-host Shahir Massoud explores the award-winning cookbook Pasta Every Day by Meryl Feinstein, demonstrating how to make fresh pasta shapes including cavatelli, farfalle and gnocchi, all paired with delicious sauces.
Chef Michael Bonacini explores the diversity of the Italian region Calabria by making fresh tuna to hearty pork to a sumptuous orange cake.
The Italian region Campania is known for its seafood and pizza. Famed Chef Michael Bonacini prepares classics like Margherita Pizza and Fried Seafood.
Rice Balls Stuffed with Seafood and Pistachio Cannoli are on the menu as Chef Michael Bonacini explores dishes from the Italian island of Sicily.

Discover what Edwin Fuhr saw in 1974 that left crop circles on his Saskatchewan farm. Then head to a Connecticut parking lot, where two men see bright lights in a UFO event that’s part of a wave of 5,000-plus sightings in the Hudson Valley.

A massive alien craft dive-bombs a pregnant Michigan woman, her family and two coast guard investigators. Then, an Argentinian woman is knocked down by a fiery blast from a UFO that doesn't want to be touched.

A cylindrical object hovers over a UK teen on her daily dog walk before shining a spotlight on an air force corporal. Then, hear from schoolkids who witnessed multiple UFOs over three memorable days in the 1960s.
In Ohio, two officers spot a strange bright light flying in the night sky. Police dispatch advises them to pursue the object, triggering a massive car chase.

Experience a scary series of encounters between an Amazonian village and a glowing ball that suddenly appears in the sky and shoots beams of light. Then get to the bottom of a panic-inducing UFO attack on a hardworking dairy farmer and his son.
A family is terrorized by a supernatural beast near their trailer park, and a woman adopts a dog only to find it's not the only thing she's brought back from the pound.
The ghosts of prisoners past make Sandra Boyd's jailhouse ghost tours a little too scary, and woman is brutally attacked by a spirit lurking in her historic home.
A woman is horrified to discover restless souls buried in the cemetery next to her house; when a man digs up an old tombstone in his yard, he unwittingly unearths a violent entity.
Paranormal activity in Evelyn Martin's new home turns from strange to scary, putting her sons in danger's way.
Witness the spooky turn sinister when ghosts reveal their nefarious past.
See how inviting ghosts into your life can go terribly wrong.
When Christopher and his friends' interest in the paranormal tempt them to visit the legendary Texas Road, they instigate a terrifying series of events.
See two people flee their homes after spirits possess their partners.
Meet ghosts that support and clash with people’s religious beliefs.
See how ghostly visitors help two people deal with the deaths of loved ones.

All 15 chefs walk into a dining room filled with Marines, where they find out they will have to cook dishes that represent the air, land and sea. Later, with the dinner service underway, things take a drastic turn when one chef accuses Chef Ramsay of sabotaging her, but can she survive making such a claim?
The chefs. still reeling from Chef Ramsay's decision to split the teams into men and women, are challenged to cook halibut seven different ways. Later, raw fish causes problems in the dinner service.
The chefs. still reeling from Chef Ramsay's decision to split the teams into men and women, are challenged to cook halibut seven different ways. Later, raw fish causes problems in the dinner service.

Chef Ramsay introduces the chefs to a culinary legend known all over the world, Mr. Potato Head. For their challenge, the chefs must create a dish with the potato as the key component. Then, tensions rise and the pressure becomes unbearable for one of the chefs, leading to the most chaotic dinner service yet.

The chefs are tasked with recreating five dishes by Chef Ramsay, but one team member has to leave every couple of minutes until it's one chef standing. Later, instead of a dinner service, the chefs compete in a cook for your life challenge - determining who is sent home.
Ramsay introduces his daughter Tilly and challenges the chefs to cook for her sweet 16. One team struggles at service, while Bret fights to stay despite severe chest pain.

After losing the latest dinner service, tension builds in the Blue team while the Red team grows closer. For their next challenge, Chef Ramsay pits the teams against each other preparing authentic Chinese dishes, judged by Shirley Chung.

With only four chefs per team, they must prepare to cook for a charity dinner service in support of St. Jude Children's Research Hospital and Waterkeeper Alliance featuring Italian food, but one team's performance forces Gordon to get involved.
The seven chefs watch ice dancers perform before Ramsay challenges them to create an extraordinary dessert, judged by chocolatier Valerie Gordon. The winner scores a luxury shopping spree.
The final six chefs battle for five black jackets across three challenges: random ingredient, same four ingredients, and surf and turf. Who misses out?
The five chefs tackle Ramsay's \.

The final four competing chefs face a tableside challenge that will send one lucky winner and their chosen partner on a luxurious day in Malibu, California. The chefs encounter a showmanship challenge that is rife with mistakes only rookies should make.

Following emotional reunions with their proud parents, Chef Ramsay tasks the final two chefs with creating five meals in only 60 minutes, with the winner earning first pick for their brigade in the final challenge.

Conclusion. After a shocking elimination, the final two chefs receive unexpected help for their final menus. They share their highs and lows with Chef Ramsay over brunch and are surprised with a visit from their families. But, the fun is short-lived, as Chef Ramsay sends the teams back to Hell’s Kitchen to learn the menus and plan for the biggest service of the finalists’ lives, taking place at Six Flags Magic Mountain.

The return of the show in which Gordon Ramsay attempts to make chefs out of aspiring American cooks, with the 18 participants this time all aged 24 or under and looking to win the head chef position at Gordon Ramsay Steak in Las Vegas. First up, the contenders all cook their signature dishes.
Tarek and Christina team up with their friend Pete De Best on a house in Yorba Linda, CA. They've flipped houses with Pete, but he's a penny pincher.
Newlyweds Gina and Stephen are moving to Madrid for the ultimate cultural immersion.
A real estate agent and his wife search for a house in Miami Beach, FL.
A young couple's backgrounds are making their first home purchase in Indianapolis a challenge.
David searches for a family who wants a home with all the little luxuries in Nashua, New Hampshire.
The hilarious, surprising, and bizarre behaviour that takes place after dark... because when the sun goes down, the neighbourhood gets wild.
After winning swimming pools, teams head outside to the backyard to create a Vegas-worthy entertaining oasis before Danny Amendola arrives to judge.
Comedians D'Arcy Carden and Sherry Cola explore California's High Desert rentals, including a lazy river resort and an artsy animal sanctuary.
A creative pair seek an artistic life and tour breathtaking bargain homes in Puglia, Italy. With an expert guide, they experience Italian countryside.
Izzy and the Battres family tackle a project with a homeowner who's terrified that a renovation will ruin the charming old house she loves.
Jack visits a sci-fi-inspired smart home with a high-tech glow. Next, he explores an earth home built into the hillside with mid-century vibes.
Tarek and Christina get a lead on a property overrun with cacti, but the tenants are still inside!
From man's best friend to wild residents of the great outdoors, this is the hilarity that ensues when human and animal worlds collide on camera.
Life is full of awkward, cringe-worthy fails that we would prefer to forget, but you can't bury the memory when the camera catches it all.
D'Arcy Carden and Sherry Cola explore the wildest rentals in the West, including an old saloon and a deluxe tiny home resort.
Follow in the footsteps of naval hero Horatio Nelson in his native Britain and explore his many influences.
Dive into the 88-plus years of history behind the Beechcraft Company which has built some of the most influential aircraft in history.
Wildfires are growing in intensity, and firefighting aviation is becoming increasingly crucial to saving forests and lives in Colorado and beyond.
New firefighting methods help California's Forestry and Fire Protection Department, the world's largest municipal fleet of firefighting aircraft.
The Century Series defined the Cold War era of aviation, charting a shift from one time period to another in the U.S. arms race with the Soviet Union.
The Learjet defined the business jet class of luxury airplanes. Now, the last Learjet is being assembled at its Wichita-based production facility.
Early outer space exploration was defined by a Space Race between the United States and the Soviet Union, in a quest for national bragging rights.
In 1862, a contrast emerged between the Union's control of the Confederate's western half and the east. Lee prepared an incursion into Union territory.

Episode 2 highlights the strategic decisions of Ulysses S. Grant and Robert E. Lee and the intense combat that defined the crucial battles of Vicksburg and Gettysburg, underscoring their impact on the broader conflict and American history. Part 2 of 3.
Gettysburg is a turning point in the war. The Union's eventual control here would be a defining moment that impacted the trajectory of the entire war.

Episode 3 showcases the intense fighting and strategic errors in the Battle of Chickamauga leading to significant losses on both sides. It then follows General Grant's Overland Campaign, a series of battles aimed at defeating General Lee's forces. Part 3 of 3.
The year 1864 marked the fourth year of the war, and after major Union victories, President Abraham Lincoln looked to bring a swift end to the war.

p.t: Aircraft Carrier: Bastions of the Sea
p.d: Aircraft carriers are vital symbols of a nation's nuclear might. Trace the history of these mighty warships.

In 1945, the world was ushered into the atomic age. With his role as the Father of the Bomb solidified, Oppenheimer became increasingly worried about the potential danger that scientific inventions could pose to humanity.
1968 was a year marked by assassinations, a contentious presidential election, an escalating anti-Vietnam War sentiment, and more.

Ingrid suffered an aneurysm after blowing her life savings on a botched reno. Mike steps in to help her daughter Natalie get it done right, with smart tips on writing contracts, choosing toughened glass and preventing leaks.

Take another look at a backyard do-over with a couple who fell for a too-good-to-be-true price. Get Mike’s best advice on hiring the right contractor for the job, setting up a proper payment schedule, and building strong retaining walls.

Janice and George lost $300K to a contractor-friend who stole millions from over 40 families. Mike picks up the pieces and shares smart advice on permits, keeping basements dry and staying proactive with plumbing.

A Toronto woman's basement floods when the city's sewage system backs up, and the insurance company hires a remediation crew that fails to follow protocol, so Mike is called upon to repair the damaged basement and save a family workshop.

p.t: Holmes 10th Anniversary Special: Behind The Overalls
p.d: Get a humorous, heartfelt look back at 10 years in the life of Canada's favourite construction pro, Mike Holmes. See how his TV career began, what a typical crew day is like, and go behind the scenes of his best on-air moments.

Sean and Carol's living room and nursery are freezing, with their baby sleeping in the cold. Mike's team conducts a full Holmes inspection and draws up a plan to turn this house into a warm, comfortable home near Grandma and Grandpa.

Head back to Sean and Carol’s place, where Mike’s team has spent weeks fixing everything from the inside out. Check out cool pest-control solutions and structural fixes before they welcome the family back to their warmed-up, safe home.

Peter and Sharon got more than they bargained for when buying a bigger home for their growing family. Mike and the crew conduct a full inspection, sealing up leaky pipes, windows and a foyer that floods every time it rains.

Kristen and Grant missed the warning signs of water trouble when buying their downtown storefront. Mike's crew looks past the sparkling kitchen and bath to make this unique urban space safe, sound and dry.

Review Kim and Jason’s home-inspection report, which failed to disclose some serious safety issues in their dream house. Head to their three-acre property with Mike and the crew, who are on a mission to turn this family nightmare around.

Get in on the ground floor of Mike and Michael's newest business venture. Take a look at the outdated suburban house that will be their first project, then get a lesson in house flipping that maximizes profit and quality construction.

Head back to the suburban house where Mike and Michael uncover one headache after another. Cheer as they find smart fixes for the wonky layout and endless stairways, then tackle issues with the open concept floor plan.

Check out Mike and Michael's latest flip—a live-work-play property on the St Lawrence River, over three hours from home. Structural issues mount before the house comes down, blowing the budget and turning the job site into a powder keg.

Brace as Mike throws Michael a curveball that shakes their business partnership. Push through snow, rain and mud as the rebuild nears completion, then admire the stunning transformation of this riverfront getaway.

A homeowner is found dead on their driveway, riddled with bullets. A family member claims to be a witness, but the chain of events raises more questions than it answers.

In this action packed episode, we travel to Australia’s favorite Playground - the Gold Coast, to prove family vacations can have it all! Fun and education; beach and the rainforest; roller coasters and wildlife. It’s a destination that’s as beautiful as it is FUN!

This episode covers fine dining in some of the most peculiar settings at the beautiful beach resort of Uga Bay in Sri Lanka then The Luxury Travel Show flies to Istanbul, the Turkish city where Europe and Asia meet.
From the beautiful Hell on earth, a small town in the Grand Cayman islands, to the equally hot planes of Toledo for a safari, Spanish style.
This gastronomic tour of Brittany stops off for a crêpe in Renne, Oysters in Cancale and some fine wines in the Turks and Caicos Caribbean islands.
Bones introduce his trademark trickery to people in Paris and Barcelona, performing mind reading and an attempt to escape a straitjacket while breakdancing.
In this episode Bones is back in his home city, London where he stuns locals with his mind reading, card trickery and disappearing skills.
Bones is in Seoul, South Korea. He explores the city by night and performs a mixture of magic tricks, including a vanishing trick, coin tricks and card tricks.
In this episode Bones is in South Korea, where he visits Taekwondo group, the K Tigers, a tarot card reader and reveals the secret to the perfect card shuffle.
London vs. Bangkok: helicopter vs. tuk tuk. Richard checks into a celeb-owned Thai hotel, while Gill enjoys skyline views of St Paul’s. Which capital—and mode of transport—wins Dave’s approval?
Gill explores Amboise, the former French royal residence and Leonardo da Vinci's resting place. Richard tours Sri Lanka's ancient temples and ruins.

Richard seeks Jet Set glory from the Iron Throne in Northern Ireland, even braving a haunted hotel. In Florence, Gill visits Michelangelo’s David and an 18th-century silk factory using Da Vinci’s original machine designs.
Dave faces a tough choice this episode: Gill is in St. Lucia, and Richard in Uga Bay, Sri Lanka—both tropical paradises with golden sands and warm seas.
From cute Koalas to the world heritage Great Barrier Reef, this family ticks off seeing two of Australia’s biggest icons and learning about their vulnerability and how as tourists we can help.

We travel to the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Canadian Rocky Mountains for their stunning natural beauty, historical castles, and epic adventures. This is a destination where protecting its natural resources comes before anything else.
Discover unknown corners of the world in our new show 'Beyond Borders'! Join our dynamic duo for an unforgettable journey filled with adventures culture and breathtaking views.
The EXO Mars and Curiosity continue their scientific discoveries as we prepare The New missions both robotic and manned to the Red planet Mars.

Terry and Larry test 2 scenes from Mel Gibson’s film Payback. Mel's character is in the back of a taxi when 4 bad guys pull up next to him in an SUV, they open fire and Mel uses a bad guy in the cab as a shield.

Terry and Larry will test different famous shots from westerns. Can you shoot a cowboy hat off the bad guy? Will a shotgun blast really throw you back through a window? Can a single shot from a colt revolver break shackles?
Terry and Larry test a famous scene from Underworld with Kate Beckensale; Terry attempts to shoot a circle around himself in the floor and fall through to save himself from the pack of werewolves.

Few films have had a bigger impact on the American psyche than “Woodstock.” Producer Dale Bell reveals what it took to create the revolutionary documentary that captured the defining moment of 1960s counterculture.
These are the most breathtaking, the most dramatic, the most important and the most fun images captured by the space program from here in our solar system to the galaxies beyond.
Host Emily Calandrelli discovers the products made for the NASA space program that now make life better down here on the ground.

From mission control to space walks - Join host Emily Calandrelli this week as she explores the unique world of Space Camp in Huntsville, AL. People from all ages come here each year to experience what its like to train like an astronaut.
In a world where nothing is what it seems, take a look at the shades of color, explore the Body transfer illusion, Liars paradox and video. Is moving pictures an illusion?

In a world where nothing is what it seems, we explore tricks using sleight of hand. Play games with a water bottle, take a look at the Dunning Kruger effect and answer the question; Is a telescope a time machine?

In a world where nothing is as it seems, play games with colour-changing milk, explore chroma keys in video editing and tackle some mental maths gymnastics. Plus the Leidenfrost effect and rethinker Linwood G. Dunn.
Two high-rises in Meaux have to be demolished without endangering the surrounding people and buildings.
In this episode, a 170-meter tower is imploded! The structure is close to a public highway, so there’s an extra element of concern for local safety.
Brendan Moar is here to uncover the people and machinery behind the worlds most dangerous and captivating demolitions.
Wiped off the face of the Earth by humans nearly a century ago, geneticists are now working on resurrecting the enigmatic Tasmanian Tiger.

Little Penelope gets a big-girl bedroom, and Lorinska takes Iva bra shopping. Jane looks for a house and starts planning her Spring Carnival outfits.

Bendigo was one of the biggest gold finds in history. It's literally built on rivers of gold. Her grand hotels and theatres have played host to international celebrities… and some shady characters too.

Like its English namesake, Australia’s Newcastle also has a reputation for toughness and heavy toil, but it’s also a town with a unique identity, a rich maritime history and more than its share of eccentric characters.

p.t: The Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
p.d: Tim visits his mate Milton in the Northern Territory to help relocate a problem croc, then back home microchips baby wombats and koalas, weighs Betty the python and then heads into the bush to check on the health of some platypus.

p.t: The Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
p.d: Tim helps a friend move a 4-meter alligator from one pond to another, all in the name of love. He introduces us to one of his big passions, the Tasmanian Devil, and later, back at the park, extracts venom from snakes and spiders.
From pineapples to passionfruit, this episode shows how to grow your own food - no matter your climate. It's time to dig in and get growing.
For tonight's Sweet Sensations Task, they have to demonstrate their burning passion by creating a dessert inspired by fire. Who will capture the drama of fire and set the judges world's alight?
We head to the Barossa Valley, SA, and take a step back in time to Mark and Jannine's '50s-inspired instant hotel. When the guests enter the shed they are blown away by the '50s diner styling.
On a quest to look hot for race day, Rachel tries cryotherapy. Iva confides in Lorinska and wonders whether Rachel and Jane like her or not.
Love guru Lorinska decides that the girls' sex lives need some serious sprucing. This queen bee takes matters into her own hands and shuffles the ladies off to the fish markets.
In this episode, a power outage hits during a surgery, a puppy party causes chaos, Scott gives rescue dog a brighter future, and tensions mount due to Scott's new project.

p.t: Gordon, Gino And Fred's Road Trip
p.d: Gino and Fred are thrilled to head to San Francisco for their own Summer of Love. Gino cant wait to explore the city that's \"all about hippies, sex, drugs, and rock and roll.\".
Gordon continues his course with budget-friendly recipes: leek and Gruyere rosti with fried eggs, a delicious apple crumble, and impressive homemade gnocchi.

Gregg and Chris have a challenge on their hands with the Rielly family from Middlesex, whose plentiful problems lead them to explore carbohydrates - should we be trying to cut them out of our diet or not?
Dame Mary Berry helps Rima, Diane, and Noreen prepare a surprise 30th birthday feast for Rima's husband, Mark. With Janette and Scarlett's help, can they create the perfect celebration?
This week it's the semifinal, and the bakers must successfully demonstrate a variety of new and different skills. The four remaining contestants begin by making a baked, layered, mousse cake.

Joe and Kirsty fell in love after meeting at work three years ago. Now they want to swap their house in Hampshire for their perfect forever home in the warmer climes of Inland Valencia in Spain.
Natalie and Matt search for a holiday home in Fuerteventura. Jean Johansson shows them five properties within their 75,000 pound budget.
A young graphic designer in love with mid century design looks to buy her first home. Ben and Erin present two options that will satisfy her love of natural elements.
Thanks to a family inheritance, a Midwestern couple is ready for the relaxing vibes of Central Florida. They're bringing in David to help search for their forever home.

Dave and Jenny purchase an '80's ranch in an up-and-coming neighbourhood to turn it into an amazing rental property; with their own money on the line, the Mars are up against a tight budget and timeline as they push toward their open house.

Claire thought she had the perfect home to raise her adopted daughter Michelle. Claire spends evenings alone downstairs while Michelle retreats upstairs. Sarah hopes that she can bring the 2 women together.

Eric Knowles presents from the Royal Welsh Showground in Builth Wells with experts Caroline Hawley and Raj Bisram as teams race to bag a bargain.
Joh and Pete visit a former smash repair business that has been transformed into a beautiful home. Adam tackles three common home maintenance issues. Karen makes Asian-inspired croquettes.
Paul and Julia prep a room for a giant billiard table. Trish aims for a greener Christmas, and Alison and Zion decorate their lodge.

Phil is with Zoe and Jason, returning to Edinburgh after a decade of living and working in Hong Kong. Meanwhile, Kirstie is attempting to balance the city and countryside desires of Stephanie and Tana.

The team take on a 45 room heritage listed property built in the 1850s. The restoration has become too much for owners Karina and Stephen, but it's 4 million asking price is a tall order in this market.

p.t: Kirstie & Phil's Love It or List It
p.d: Kirstie and Phil head to Brampton to help soon-to-be empty-nesters Richard and Bridget with their boxy 90s home. Kirstie suggests a clever conversion, and Phil shows them three jaw-dropping properties.
Kirstie's with nurse Gwyneth and her husband James, who have £320,000 and want to buy a house close to Glasgow where they can start a family.
Alistair Appleton helps a Doncaster couple find a home in the Welsh Valleys and meets volunteers from the local mountain rescue.
Twelve-year-old Jade is rushed to King's after being hit by a car and knocked under a bus whilst walking to school; doctors fear a fractured skull.
Celebrity Goggleboxers review the best TV of 2023 including The Masked Singer, FBoy Island Australia, Married At First Sight and Selling Houses Australia.

Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada. See how they can move from safety to target by crossing a line they had no say in creating.

Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuleta's loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

Travel to a remote part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets. Do they make friends? Where do they give birth? Are some bolder than others? The answers may help protect these supreme predators for generations to come.

Travel to the ends of Australia's shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican who's swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble.

Complete the trip's final lap in the untamed lands where Australia's interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

Embrace the Bulwa family’s excitement as Beverley helps them find an exceptional rescue pooch in need of a second chance. Search for the perfect fit and meet Lily, a schnauzer-terrier mix; Brewster, a terrier cross; and Bubba, a French bulldog.

Rudi the cat, a 21-year-old feline, heads to Dr. Scott's clinic to have a large mass removed from her ear; the owner of a diabetic Chihuahua receives bad news concerning their pet; a rabbit with large teeth needs medical assistance.

Go inside the clinic as the two vets team up to save the vision of two young kittens. Then, Brian the budgie needs a new home while Skully the dog needs leg surgery. Finally, Dr. Scott goes head-to-head with Claude, a feisty French bulldog.

Hang out with Will and Rachael at an orphaned-rhino sanctuary and see vet Emily cheat death during a giraffe relocation. Watch warthogs run Emma ragged and examine marine biologist Alison’s smart solution for plastic pollution on the Western Cape.

Two diminutive orphan animals experience a difficult time with survival as they do whatever they possibly can to stay alive; Hope decides to give a release another attempt after the first try did not go as they initially planned.

Gamble on high-stakes surgery to save Juno the Staffie, whose illness is only one of 20 cases worldwide. Check in on Tim as he attends to a rash of Tasmanian devil facial tumours, and witness a rehabilitated pelican’s return to the wild.

Ziggy the cat has a big problem – he weighs almost a third more than he should. Chris needs to re-educate both the cat and the devoted owner to ensure the cats deteriorating health is not compromised further.

Focus on an orphaned wallaroo (a kangaroo-wallaby cross) who needs ER attention, then meet a pup looking for a little nip and tuck to address the rolls of fat blocking his vision. Later, check on a sick Dalmatian who’s swallowed something verboten.

Look on as the vets help a Tasmanian devil with reproductive issues and a suspicious sore. Commiserate with a python fighting a toothache and Lucky the cat, who could use some, well, luck. Then tackle a ducky rescue mission with Chris.

Explore a Noah’s Ark household, complete with hand-raised sheep and chickens running around the yard. Listen in as Dr. Lisa helps newlywed animal lovers Cheyne and Danielle find a dream pup to add to their blossoming family.

Get a look inside Kylie’s small inner city apartment, where space is definitely at a premium. Find out why Dr. Lisa is hesitant to give this career woman the all-clear to add a dog to her home, despite all the nice walking spots nearby.

Feel the pressure as Dr. Lisa deals with the Chambers family’s disagreements over dog ownership. Meet 22-year-old Jess, who desperately wants a pooch who can accommodate her needs and her beloved horses, and win over her reluctant mum.

Julien And Nicolette have three daughters, and Keira, 4, has an irrational fear of dogs. Dr. Lisa advises that the best thing to do might be to get a dog. Will the cure work and what special issues do three young girls put in her way?

Assess the damage when Watson arrives with a slashed eyeball after a brawl with the family cat. See if surgery will fix a fox injured in a hit-and-run, then tear up at an emotional reunion with one of Dr. Scott’s cherished clients.

Board a plane bound for a new adventure in Central America. Join Hope and Dr. Barry as they team up with front-line wildlife rescuers in Costa Rica. Explore the jungles and meet the exotic animals that make their homes in this vital ecosystem.

Jamie and Adam investigate the claim that an action movie hero can protect the other cast members from a grenade explosion by moving quickly; next, they tackle the urban legend that mixing Diet Coke and Mentos can be fatal.

Just when you think Adam and Jamie have tested every gun legend in history, they come up with three more myths. All have a real-life history, and some have since been adapted for the movies. Meantime, Kari, Grant and Tori go to great lengths to see whether mankind's first and simplest tool could be far more dangerous than you think.
Myths tested: Is it possible to survive a 22,000-foot fall using the blast from a 1000-pound bomb to break the fall? Is electricity saved by switching off the lights when leaving a room?

Not a show goes by without some disgruntled fan writing an angry email to say that Adam and Jamie messed something up, so the fans were asked to put their money where their mouths are in this MailBag Special.
'Tis the season to bust Holiday myths. Whether you think the Yuletide season is the most magical time of the year or a bunch of bah-humbug, it's full of fables to unwrap.

Arggghhh me hearties... Jamie and Adam have plundered the seven seas in search of pirate parables and maritime myths and the result is this 2-hour spectacular. And with four stories of hi-jinks on the high seas the action is thick and fast.
Adam and Jamie turn dirigible detectives to try and solve one of aeronautics biggest puzzles. Plus Kari, Tory and Grant come face-to-face, and have to flee from some of Nature's natural-born killers.

On this episode of MythBusters, Jamie and Adam test the stuff of nightmares in Underwater Car. If you are unfortunate enough to drive your vehicle into the drink, is it possible to escape or will a watery grave be your fate?

As self-confessed speed enthusiasts, hosts Adam Savage and Jamie Hyneman explore the world of speed cameras and speed traps, following fast cars as they attempt to evade the very cameras that are designed to slow them down.
Is it possible to teach an Old Dog New Tricks? In attempt to find an answer Adam and Jamie go head to head with a pair of untrained middle-aged Malamute Huskies.

Every so often the mythbusters draw conclusions that leave the fans seething. Well, once again, it's time for the mythbusters to put some of their most contentious outcomes under the microscope, in Myths Revisited.
Grant, Tory and Kari go deeper into the world of hypnosis, while Adam and Jamie appear to be under some sort of influence, as they make some truly extraordinary sounds in the name of science.
It's the ultimate brainteaser. If a truck carrying a full load of birds hits a bump in the road, and all the birds take flight, is that truck now lighter?

The MythBusters stage an East-meets-West showdown as they study the mythology surrounding Ninjas, gathering the entire team for the challenge as they weigh science against the mysteries behind martial arts techniques.
Adam and Jamie test Wild West myths while Kari, Tory, and Grant tackle airbag legends—history meets modern science with horses, cars, guns, and explosions.
For people who live on active volcanoes, life has an element of impermanence to it. There is always the fear that one day their turn will come, and their home will be in the path of the volcano.
Watch a desert landscape transform into a lush frenzy of feeding and breeding.
It sometimes feels like mammals rule the world; there are well over 5,000 species, colonising every corner of the globe. But in Arabia there’s a different story – this is a land where reptiles rule.

The Arabian Desert is one of the most challenging places on earth, but the animals here are resilient and specialized. Even for the hardiest inhabitants, death’s never far away. Creatures must seize every opportunity to find food, shelter and water. Adaptability is the key to dune survival.
Spoonbill Soft Shoe Shuffle: The team help a trio of troubled baby wallabies and a koala having seizures. Plus, a kookaburra has surgery and a spoonbill gets corrective shoes.
The clinic deals with the aftermath of a Brisbane flood, while a baby kangaroo is in need of round-the-clock care. Vet Karina tackles the turtle waiting list.
Vet Karina fights to save a koala mauled by dogs. Plus, rescue Chantel tries to pick up a peeved possum, while vet Meaghan bonds with a gaggle of goslings.

This is the story of the “Golden Forest”, the vast expanses of kelp that lines Africa’s southwestern shore. Fed by an upwelling of nutrients from deep in the Atlantic, the kelp forest nurtures four distinct worlds.

Kenya’s making a massive move towards setting up the country's first community-run rhino sanctuary. Find out why Lewa reckons it's the right call, and watch the teams as they shift rhinos from all over the shop to this new conservancy.
Kenyan capture teams head to the Somalian border to find 50 rare antelopes and bring them to a safe enclosure, where their numbers can recover.
Engage in a game of cat and mouse with nature’s top mimics and stealthy hunters.
Love and war go hand in hand, for there are hunters who cooperate to maximize their captures and others who turn neglected lovers into a fast and easy meal.
Two blue penguins are followed along New Zealand's southern coast to reveal their personal journeys to find mates so that they can reproduce.
New Zealand's west coast is like nowhere else. From glacier-covered mountains and rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief.
In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier.

Autumn and Jordan are engaged but their relationship has been rocky because Autumn says she has found Jordan talking to other women over the internet; Dennis has distrusted Cassie since she cheated on him, yet he openly cheats on her.

William received a strange voicemail and became convinced his girlfriend Jo was drugging him and sneaking men into their house to cheat. Donovan believes Lacara has been cheating, but she says she confessed so the accusations would stop.

Jared says that he is positive that his wife Sarah is cheating on him and he admits to physically abusing Sarah because he says he hates being lied to. Sarah, who is pregnant, says that she's desperate to stop Jared's abusing ways.

Elaina and her husband Lennard claim their daughter was raped by her brother-in-law Lenel. Lenel’s fiancée and Elaina’s sister, Elissa, believes they’re making up this entire story. Don’t miss the shocking results today!

Angel claims that her father Ronald abused her sexually, forced her to do drugs and even got her addicted to crack when she was 18. His other daughter Tracy also claims he’s tried to abuse her several times, but Ronald says he’s innocent!

Shantee has been forced into prostitution by her boyfriend Tim. When she refused, he beat her, once causing her to suffer a miscarriage. Tim prides himself on controlling and using her as property, but Steve isn’t about to let this continue!

Lagraciala tragically lost her 10 month old son and cremated him, but after a serious fight with her fiancée AJ, she couldn't find the ashes. AJ admits to threatening to steal the ashes, but denies he took them!
A man claims that his ex-girlfriend has abandoned their son, and found out that he isn't listed on his son's birth certificate and wants a DNA test.

Melissa suspects that her long-distance boyfriend is not real, but is a false persona created by her best friend; a text message from a stranger informs Beverly that her husband is posting on numerous websites to cheat on her.
Donnie's wife disappeared with his cousin for hours and refused to take his phone calls; another parent told Angelina that her boyfriend was cheating with a prostitute.

A couple of 15 years encounters a difficult position in their relationship with accusations of lying and infidelity coming from both parties; a girlfriend discovers that her boyfriend remained married to another woman during their relationship.

Lianna and Devone have been married for a year, but she suspects Devone of being unfaithful because he stays out all night and is rarely home. Then, Kya is out on a $50,000 bond for allegedly abusing her newborn son, but did she do it?
A man takes a lie-detector test after being accused of hurting his girlfriend's child.

Deon believes that Cassandra has been having sex with Josh and that she may be pregnant with his child! Next, Shawn believes his wife, Jamie, cheated on him with his brother. Jamie blacked out during a night of drinking and does not remember.

Arianne's husband has been a stripper at a gay club for years, and she fears he is having sex with the men; Kendra left her boyfriend when she saw text messages between him and another woman, who told her she thought he was single.

The Northern and Southern boats fight for the title in the final two days of the season.

Opening day of fishing season in the Outer Banks pits the best captains from the North and South against each other - and the elements. This time around, the veteran fishermen are hungrier than ever for a win, but some new faces threaten to put their crews to the test. As the competition gets going FV-Tuna.Com decides to join the southern fleet for the first time, but the violent southern waters may prove to be too much for the five-time winner from the north.

Captain Nick Gowitzka on Little Shell has long touted the greenstick as the secret to his success. But not everyone in the fleet believes its a necessary tool to catch giant bluefin down south and would rather rely on rod and reel. Meanwhile, Pinwheel is the only boat in the fleet yet to catch a fish this season. Their desperation swells as they fear they could quickly be falling too far behind to ever catch up.
Will the greenstick continue to give the Little Shell an edge, or will his more traditional rod-and-reel rivals prove victorious in the long run?
Time is money in the search for blue gold, and as the pressure builds, financial concerns weigh heavy on the captains minds.
The captains must choose between fight or flight when harsh conditions pummel the fleet.
As the top boats solidify their spots in the race, Greg and his mates cant seem to stay in sync, and the former champion boat starts to fall apart.

The competition for bluefin intensifies as the crews continue to battle each other and the elements. Currently, FV-Tuna.com is sitting at the top of the leader board, with local team Little Shell in a close second. However, one crew member's earth-shattering loss could alter the rest of the season.

Conditions in the Outer Banks can make finding the bluefin especially tricky, and the captains rely on sharing information throughout the fleet. But Captain Dave Carraro of the FV-Tuna.com has a few tricks up his own sleeve and doesn’t want to play by the rules, living up to his long-standing nickname “Tricky Dave” and causing the rest of the fleet to talk amongst themselves.

A mate emergency leaves the Hot Tuna crew down a man, which will push the father and son team to the limit. While most of the remaining boats are also struggling, Little Shell and Pinwheel enjoy some much needed good luck. Sitting in last place is the Reel E Buggings crew who are desperate to get back into the competition.

After a busy few weeks of ups and downs, Fishing Frenzy is now leading the fleet, but Hot Tuna and Pinwheel are close behind, piling on the pressure. As the quota fills up, the captains must decide if skill or luck is in their favour in order to pull ahead in the competition.
The seas around the tuna grounds can be both violent and unforgiving of any error or lapse in judgement.
The fleet communicates in order to find fish, but some captains will have to check every lead.
The tuna titan battle continues while mates try to keep pace. From family ties to lifelong friends, which team has the drive to put meat on the deck?
With the end of the season drawing near, the fleet is desperate to catch. Some fishermen are focused while others let their tempers take over.
